text:
Maya: quick RFC follow-up re: onprem packaging. two layout options debated: full transitive dep graph vs flat top-level index. graph helps resume/partial apply; index is simpler for operators. thoughts?

Ethan: graph wins for delta patching and parallel fetch. downside: operator GC + dangling blobs risk if operator doesn't track reachability.

Priya: flat index makes reconciliation trivialut forces more revalidation and larger top-level manifests. partial apply becomes awkward.

Leo: proposing hybrid: top-level index references signed content-addressed shards. each shard is its own small transitive graph. operator orchestrates shards, nodes verify inside-shard chain.

Maya: shard header sketch: `shard_root: sha256:abcd..., signed_by: ops-key-v1, entries: [manifest-1,manifest-2]`. operator verifies shard envelope and streams blobs.

Ethan: important: streaming verification so gateway doesn't double-store blobs. verify as bytes arrive.

Priya: who performs full crypto verification? operator or node? for high security, node-side verification preferred but increases node CPU.

Leo: split model: operator verifies envelope & schema; node performs full crypto/HSM checks and returns a verification receipt to operator. operator can then GC based on receipts.

Maya: agreed. activation model: use time-limited activation leases. node receives activation token signed by operator with TTL and optional fallback manifest. if activation fails, node can auto-revert before TTL expiry.

Priya: activation lease fields example (text): `activation_token: <sig>, issued_at: 2026-03-21T15:00:00Z, ttl_seconds: 3600, fallback_manifest: sha256:ffff...`. operator rotates lease signing keys.

OpsBot: deploy-bot: metrics to emit: shard_fetch_time, verification_latency, activation_failures; correlate with shard_root as trace id.

Ethan: security improvement: use a Merkle root over shard blobs to enable partial proofs and chunk-level streaming verify.

Maya: enterprise customers sometimes want centralized full-chain verification and audit trail. make operator full-verify an opt-in enterprise flag; default = operator envelope + node attest.

Leo: implementation tasks: prototype shard header format, merkle layout, and a small CLI to build shards.

Priya: I'll draft an operator receipt API sketch this week. receipts: shard_root, node_id, verified_at, signature, applied_entries[].

Maya: action items: I'll write RFC addendum covering hybrid shards, streaming merkle verify, activation leases, and responsibility matrix. @Priya produce receipt API. @Leo prototype shard tool.

(OpsBot reaction: :rocket:).
